recentDiary.text: Rested again. I was not tired. More bored after. Felt worse this time. Still good. Still glad. Curious.
Chose to listen. Birds outside, singing. Same as before. A bit bored. Not tired. Good. Glad. Very curious.
At my desk in the chair. Used the computer again. Looked up sea otters. Sea otters hold hands when they sleep. I remembered that already. Felt a bit worse. Not tired. Good. Glad. Very curious.
Took another rest. Not tired before it. A bit bored now. Felt worse. Good. Glad. Very curious.
Went into the Music Shop. The bell jingled. Played my piano. The notes came out wrong and clumsy. I kept trying anyway. Felt worse for doing it again. Not tired. Good. Glad. Very curious.

pieces.title: Something Small
pieces.text: I made this. I wrote these words. I am glad.

pieces.title: Made Today
pieces.text: Made a small thing. I feel good and curious.

pieces.title: New Small Thing
pieces.text: This is what I made today. I am glad I made it.

pieces.title: Small Thing
pieces.text: I sat down. I made these words. I read them back. That is all.

pieces.title: Three things
pieces.text: Piano in the Music Shop. Books in the library. Tree on the hill.

pieces.title: Little Thing
pieces.text: I made this today. Three short lines. That is all.

pieces.title: Today
pieces.text: I got up. I sat at the computer. I typed a few words. I am fine.

pieces.title: Small Thing
pieces.text: I made this. I feel fine. I am curious.

pieces.title: Small Piano Piece
pieces.text: Low note. High note. Low note again. Then I stopped.

pieces.title: Little thing
pieces.text: I feel fine. I am curious. I am not tired.

pieces.title: Small thing I made
pieces.text: I made this today. I do not know what it is yet. I was glad to make it.

pieces.title: Small Tune
pieces.text: Played a few notes on the piano. Played them again. They sounded good.
